Message:
drm/i915: Stop updating plane->fb/crtc

We want to get rid of plane->fb/crtc on atomic drivers. Stop setting
them.

v2: Fix up the comment in intel_crtc_active() and
    nuke the rest of the stale comments (Daniel)
